newsitem.title: USA: Telcom sees Q2 sales up slightly from Q1.
newsitem.headline: Telcom sees Q2 sales up slightly from Q1.

text.p: TelCom Semiconductor Inc, a maker of high-performance integrated circuits, on Thursday said it expected second-quarter sales to exceed the first quarter's $11.1 million.
"We believe that second-quarter sales should be slightly higher than first quarter," the company said in a statement accompanying its results for the three months to March 31.

For the first quarter, Telcom reported a loss of $0.45 a share, including an $8.0 million charge, versus a profit of $0.02 per share. Excluding the charge, the company would have reported earnings of $0.04 a share in the first quarter of 1997.
Sales were $9.1 million in the year-earlier quarter.
